The catalogue or catalog (also called S. Percell Co's Fyne & Mysterious Giftes Catalogue) lets players win special decorations, diamonds, products, supplies, boosters, vouchers in exchange for gift cards.

It is unlocked at experience level 15, along with Alfred, the mailman. For more information about mailboxes see Mailbox.

The catalogue

The catalogue has 4 pages showcasing four types of Mystery Packages at the same time. The first three are always the same. The last one is renewed every week, with an eight-hour break between changes. This pause can be skipped by spending one diamond.

Types of packages

There are seven different types of packages: small, medium, large, deco, tool, town and booster packages.


Small Mystery Package

Small packages cost 10 cards. Players can win 1 , 5dia or any other item(s).

Medium Mystery Package

Medium packages cost 20 cards. Players can win 1 , 10dia or any other item(s).

Large Mystery Package

Large packages cost 30 cards. Players can win 1 , 15dia or any other item(s).

Mystery Deco Packages

Deco packages cost either 25 or 35 cards. In 25-card packages, players can win 1 or any other decoration.

In 35-card packages, players can win 1 or any other decoration.

Tool Mystery Packages

Tool packages cost 5 cards. Players can win one or more supplies.

Town Mystery Packages

Town packages cost 10 cards. Players can win 1 town expansion supply (brick, hand drill, map piece, paint bucket or stone block).

Booster Mystery Packages

Booster packages cost 10 cards. Players can win any boosters.

Holiday Catalogue

Holiday Catalogue is a brand new holiday extension of Postman catalogue. It has been added in Winter 2022 update, and is available for limit time, December 5th, 2022 to January 2nd, 2023.

Player can spend Holly (special event currency) in this special catalogue, and every week, new rewards will be unlocked and previous rewards will no longer be available.

There are many reward types what players can buy: coins, vouchers, supplies, boosters, blueprints, puzzle pieces, and holiday decoration. This table shows numbers of holly require to purchase each item in each week. Number in bracket are amount of reward will you get.

Birthday Catalogue

Birthday Catalogue is a brand new holiday extension of Postman catalogue. It has been added in June 2024 update, and is available for limit time, from June 11th, 2024.

Player can spend musical note (special event currency as holly or chocolate bunny) in this special catalogue, and every week, new rewards will be unlocked and previous rewards will no longer be available.

On the 2026 anniversary, a new currency appears: yellow flower.

There are many reward types what players can buy: coins, vouchers, supplies, boosters, blueprints, puzzle pieces, and birthday decoration.
